The '''BL-37 Zephyr''' was a model of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] created by [[Vectron]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
